record.paper_title: Results and open problems in matchings in regular graphs
record.original_question: For arbitrary infinite r-regular graphs that need not be bipartite, what is the correct analog of the asymptotic lower matching conjecture for p-matching entropy at densities p in [0,2/3]? In particular, what explicit lower-bound function should h_G(p) satisfy in that non-bipartite setting?

evidence.quote: There should be a similar inequality for infinite r-regular graphs, at least for p ∈ [0, 2/3] as we explain in §7. However we do not have the precise version of such inequality.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be an infinite $r$-regular graph (not necessarily bipartite). For a finite $r$-regular graph $H$ on $n$ vertices, let $m_k(H)$ denote the number of matchings of $H$ of size $k$, and for $p \in [0,1]$ define the normalized matching entropy
$$ h_H(p) = \frac{1}{n}\ln m_{\lfloor pn/2\rfloor}(H). $$
For an infinite $r$-regular graph $G$, define $h_G(p)$ as the limit of $h_{H_n}(p)$ along any Benjamini–Schramm convergent sequence of finite $r$-regular graphs $H_n \to G$ (assume such a limit exists and is independent of the sequence).

For the bipartite case, the asymptotic lower matching conjecture asserts that, for every $p\in[0,1]$,
$$ h_G(p) \;\ge\; \frac{1}{2}\Big( p\ln r - p\ln p - 2(1-p)\ln(1-p) + (r-p)\ln(1-p/r)\Big), $$
with equality for the infinite $r$-regular tree.

Problem: Determine the correct analog of this asymptotic lower matching inequality for arbitrary infinite $r$-regular graphs $G$ that need not be bipartite, valid at least for matching densities $p \in [0,2/3]$. Specifically, find an explicit function $L_r(p)$ (depending only on $r$ and $p$) such that
$$ h_G(p) \;\ge\; L_r(p) \qquad \text{for all } p\in[0,2/3] $$
holds for every infinite $r$-regular graph $G$, and which is sharp on a natural extremal $r$-regular (non-bipartite) graph.
artifact.status_search_result: Searches indicate that the asymptotic lower matching conjecture and its sharp form are established (and partially proved) for bipartite r-regular graphs via results connected to Schrijver's and Gurvits's theorems, but a precise non-bipartite analog of the lower bound for the p-matching entropy h_G(p) on the range p ∈ [0,2/3] has not been formulated explicitly nor proved in the literature available. The non-bipartite case remains open.

status_evidence.title: Lower matching conjecture, and a new proof of Schrijver's and Gurvits's theorems
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes the lower matching conjecture for bipartite r-regular graphs.
status_evidence.claim: The bipartite version of the conjecture has been proved; non-bipartite analog not addressed.

status_evidence.title: On the Validations of the Asymptotic Matching Conjectures
status_evidence.snippet: Studies p-monomer entropy for r-regular bipartite graphs and tori.
status_evidence.claim: Asymptotic matching conjectures discussed primarily in the bipartite setting.

status_evidence.title: Matchings and Independent Sets of a Fixed Size in Regular Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses extremal counts of k-matchings in regular graphs; non-bipartite sharp lower bound for entropy not given on [0,2/3].
status_evidence.claim: No explicit non-bipartite analog of the asymptotic lower matching inequality is established.
